newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmen leader to spend four days at Turkey clinic.
newsitem.headline: Turkmen leader to spend four days at Turkey clinic.

text.p: Turkmenistan's president, Saparmurat Niyazov, flew to Turkey on Thursday where he will undergo medical checks in an Istanbul clinic and hold talks with Turkish officials.

"For the first four days I will take a course of post-operative treatment in the Istanbul branch of the Houston clinic," Niyazov said on Turkmen state television late on Wednesday on the eve of his departure.
Turkmenistan's foreign affairs ministry confirmed Niyazov's departure for Turkey on Thursday and said the Turkmen president would meet Turkish officials on November 18-19.
Niyazov, 56, underwent an operation to remove a blood clot from his leg at a hospital in Houston, Texas, in 1994.
Known as "Turkmenbashi" or "leader of the Turkmens", Niyazov is the subject of a strong personality cult in the energy-rich desert nation of 3.9 million.
